content: We follow the evaluation methodology defined by BIBREF9 for SAIL where we use three-fold validation, and in each fold, we use two maps for training (90%) and validation (10%) and test on the third one. We report a sized-weighted average test result. For all models we report the accuracy per single sentences and full paragraphs. Success is measured by generating an exact route, not striding away from the path. The last position on the path should be within five tile euclidean distance from the intended destination, as the position explained in the instruction might not be specific enough for one tile. In single-sentences, the last position should also be facing the correct direction.
